CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation tied to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red/blue locations) is identified and bound to a current record with an explicit origin/status field.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement tied to the same content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Report explicitly names content instances (red/blue) and their location sets.

D.rationale: Content entries are accompanied by separate origin/status metadata, distinguishing identification from status/source.

O.rationale: Text states how identified contents are presented/accessible in current records (explicit sets under p0/current/*).
